app.title: Dota 2 Highlight Recorder
list.title: Local replays
list.hint: Find a match under Watch → Match History in the game and click Download; it will show up here.
list.empty: No replays yet. Find a match under Watch → Match History in the game and click Download.
match.title: Match {id}
match.noClips: This player has no kills in the match, so there is nothing to record.
match.summary: {n} of {total} clips selected · {secs} of video · about {minutes} min to record
rec.confirm.title: Start recording
rec.confirm.what: Record {n} clips, {secs} of video, about {minutes} min (not counting the game start).
rec.confirm.handsOff: Don't touch the mouse or keyboard while recording: the program clicks the game's UI, and stops as soon as it notices your input.
rec.confirm.stop: To stop early, move the mouse or press {hotkey}; clips already recorded are kept.
rec.confirm.restart: Dota is started if needed (with the console port, so it can't join matchmaking — quit it afterwards and start it from Steam). Changed game settings are restored afterwards.
rec.ask.title: Please confirm
rec.title: Recording
rec.handsOff: Don't touch the mouse or keyboard. To stop, move the mouse or press {hotkey}.
rec.result.title: Result
ev.waitQuit: Dota is running normally; recording needs it restarted with the console port. Please quit Dota (main menu → Exit); recording continues once it has closed.
ev.countdown: Taking over the game UI in {secs} s…
ev.noHotkey: The stop hotkey {hotkey} is taken by another program; move the mouse to stop
ev.restoringSize: Quitting the game to put the window size back to {w}×{h}…
ev.sizeNotRestored: Couldn't put the window size back ({error}); set it to {w}×{h} in the game's video settings
ev.diag: Screenshots and logs for troubleshooting are in {dir}
rules.title: Clip rules (advanced)
rules.anchor: Fight start is based on damage between
rules.maxLead: Start at most this long before the kill (s)
rules.keepGap: Keep idle gaps inside a clip up to (s)
settings.title: Settings
settings.resolution.hint: If it differs from the current game window, the game is restarted for recording; afterwards the game quits and your window size is put back.
settings.compile.hint: Also join all clips into one video
settings.ffmpeg.hint: ffmpeg.exe or its folder. Leave empty to search the program folder, the D2HR_FFMPEG variable and PATH.
